```python
import statistics as stats

red = [24, 74, 54, 28, 33, 73, 68, 60, 59, 40, 72, 76, 75, 48, 34, 62, 55, 31, 24, 51, 38, 46, 66, 76, 76, 53, 51]
green = [39, 28, 29, 73, 64, 72, 47, 53, 64, 74, 65, 40, 26, 27, 37, 31, 70, 44, 64, 65, 55, 78, 35, 61, 41, 77, 49]

red_pst = stats.pstdev(red)
green_s = stats.stdev(green)
avg = (red_pst + green_s) / 2
print("Red count:", len(red))
print("Green count:", len(green))
print("red_pstdev:", round(red_pst, 3))
print("green_stdev:", round(green_s, 3))
print("average_std:", round(avg, 3))
print("Final result:", round(avg, 3))
```
